body:
multisession-tabs: a capability with no discoverable path is not a capability.

Aman could not work out how to get two logins for the same site, and nothing was broken — the model supports it (two logins for one site means two personas, which is what keeps "open this persona" unambiguous). Reaching it meant creating a persona, finding a tab already on that site, and pressing +. Nobody guesses that. Worse, "Duplicate" was the obvious-looking button and does the OPPOSITE of what is wanted: it clones the same login.

The fix was never a model change. It was one action, offered where the thought occurs: "Another login for this site" in the session row's menu and in the current-tab bar, doing the whole journey — new persona named after the site (numbered, skipping taken names), one empty session, opened SIGNED OUT and ready.

Signed out is the load-bearing part: inheriting the first login makes the whole exercise pointless, and is exactly what an un-isolated tab does. Pinned by spike/e2e-twologins.mjs.

Generalise: when a user says "I cannot do X" and X is in fact supported, do not explain the sequence — collapse it into one action sited where they were standing when they wanted it.
